ModuleDescription: Direct TCP/UDP eye tracking from an existing aGlass Runtime 1.1, with optional Python bridge compatibility for other SDKs. No SteamVR required in direct FOV mode.
UsageInstructions: Start and calibrate aGlass Runtime 1.1, ensure its USB Key authorization is ready, then reload this module. Source=runtime (default package) needs no Python bridge. Source=bridge uses local OSC UDP 9015. Do not run both tracking clients simultaneously. Eyelids are estimated from validity. See README.md and aGlassVRCFT.json beside the DLL.
